## Summary

Describe the user-visible result and why this change is needed.

## Governance tier

- [ ] Governance-lite: documentation-only correction with no behavior, product-claim,
  acceptance-criterion, security, architecture, policy, courtroom, or schema change.
- [ ] Governed: all other changes.

For governance-lite, explain why it qualifies. For a governed change, link the applicable
evidence, decision record, and acceptance material.

## Validation

List the focused checks or inspection performed, and explain any relevant check not run.

## Safety

- [ ] No credentials, private data, or unrelated generated artifacts are included.
- [ ] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
